name: Config Class Validates API Keys for OpenAI
description: Checks that the Config class raises a ValueError if OPENAI_API_KEY is missing when LLM_PROVIDER is 'openai'.
input: Environment variable LLM_PROVIDER set to 'openai', OPENAI_API_KEY missing.
output: ValueError is raised indicating missing OPENAI_API_KEY.
error_scenarios: No exception raised when API key is missing
